name: doodad-flag-bits
description: Fix Doodads on Load: flag bits above 4 (0x08 to 0xff, inside and outside the playable area): the editor's save keeps bits 0 to 3 only (0x1e to 0x0e, 0x80 to 0x02); Studio's fixed-on-load save does the same

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); window.__driveEd.pushEdit({ undo() {}, redo() {}, terrain: false, objects: false });

name: doodad-scale-one-axis-zero
description: Fix Doodads on Load: a scale with one or two axes at 0. Destructables (LTbr, LTcr) get one random scale for all axes only when x is 0 (x nonzero: clamped x for all); doodads (LOch) a random value for each zero axis. The random picks differ by design (ignored here: scales of destructables with x 0, zero axes of LOch); every other scale matches
